_doc: Single source for the visible surface of the atlas operating contract. Read by hooks/completion_gate.py (conditions n, o, p), scripts/atlas_todo.py (item phase, scaffold), hooks/todo_capture.py (Claude TodoWrite -> board) and omp/index.ts (omp todo phases -> board). The header text itself is defined in output-styles/atlas-orchestrator.md; scripts/turn_scoring.py HEADER_RE is a looser telemetry regex (matches anywhere) and is not this contract. phases[] is the one phase table: id (the word the header carries and a todo item's phase), glyph, label (the fixed-case word a surface prints; lowercase, the case the header pattern accepts) tone (an atlas-ui Token the mod paints the phase with) and cell (the single-cell glyph a narrow surface prints; mod/theme.ts contractGlyph reads it). mod/contract-pattern.ts holds a code copy of it (the host loader refuses a .json import from a mod module) that mod/contract-pattern.test.ts keeps equal. A todo item carries its phase as: the omp todo phase name (lowercase phase id), or on Claude Code TodoWrite a content prefix '[<phase>] ' (for example '[verify] run the suites'). The three visibility conditions (n header, o phased todo, p colony channel) ask the model to repair presentation: o and p each block at most once per session, and n blocks every header-less reply up to the loop limit (ATLAS_GATE_BLOCK_LOOP, default 3 consecutive uncorrected blocks). headerTemplate carries the bold brand the output style asks for; the gate pattern accepts the plain `ATLAS |` form as well. The header brand is plain `ATLAS` or, for surfaces where the mod does not draw the chip, the markdown `**ATLAS**`; the glyph is required in both. Gate and mod read the first non-empty line of a reply, split on \n only and stripped of ASCII whitespace only (space, tab, CR, VT, FF; contracts/header-corpus.json pins both parsers).
